asset_manifest.pose: An adult female grad student of Asian ethnicity with short black hair wearing a light red tee shirt under a khaki safari vest, red shorts, and black hiking boots laughs and points at a massive T-Rex footprint in the sand. A small green juvenile dinosaur is napping inside the track, while a stylized T-Rex with a comically expressive grin stands nearby.

visual_notes.text_style: Bright Red, high-poly 3D mixed case text with a glossy finish to match the STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3 aesthetic.
visual_notes.ground_texture: High-relief orange sand dunes with deep tridactyl footprint impressions consistent with the DJADOKHTA formation.
visual_notes.character_consistency: The T-Rex maintains its blocky head and tiny two-fingered hands; the paleontologist follows the specific uniform and physical description of character ID dino_bones_paleontologist_5.
